### The Core Difference
*   **Pruning** removes unnecessary parts of the model (reducing size by removing weights).
*   **Quantization** reduces the precision of the numbers used in the model (reducing size by reducing bits).

While both aim to make models faster, smaller, and more memory-efficient, they work on fundamentally different principles.

Summarize the concept of attention in transformers.

Here is a summary of the concept of attention in Transformers, structured from its fundamental mechanism to its evolution.

### 1. Core Definition
**Attention** is a mechanism that allows a model to focus on specific parts of the input sequence when processing a particular token. Unlike older Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) which process data sequentially and lose context over long distances, attention allows the model to **directly access** information from any part of the sequence in parallel.

In the Transformer architecture, attention replaces the recurrent and convolutional layers entirely.
